A real adult hand enters from the top edge and firmly grips the can's arched handle, visibly supporting its weight. The same broad twilight environment lights the skin, metal, water and flower; tiny droplets catch pale highlights while the porous stone stays matte and detailed. Compose the complete can, hand grip, stream and flower as an elegant descending diagonal with generous lateral separation, sharp product edges and a softly graded blue background. The orange petals are the only saturated warm object, and the metal surfaces are plain and unmarked. Render at 1152 by 2048 pixels.

review.notes: Hand grip verified at 1024px: four curled fingers plus a thumb with a visible nail wrapping the arched handle - no extra or missing digit. Snow settles on shoulders and on the shelter roof. Each posture and gaze carries its own small story of waiting; the kneeling giant's gentle patience anchors the right side of the frame, balancing the queue's diagonal flow toward the warm bus headlights approaching along the left edge.
